flags.message: Context freezes distribution_count=1 (DISTRIBUTED for Conference of 9/28/2026), but a Court-initiated 'Response Requested' entry on Aug 26 pulled the petition from that conference before it was considered; the BIO is now due Oct 26. The redistribution that must follow the BIO will resolve relist-increment as a rise although it is a first consideration, not a relist. My relist-increment number (0.97) prices that mechanical redistribution, not a relist signal. Separately, the frozen band is `baseline` while the docket shows a CFR after waiver plus three amicus filings (22 states, NSSF, NRA/SAF); sal-v4 does not condition on a CFR, so my P(grant) departs far from the band anchor by design, not by data error.
